subject: act-tr
title: ACT.TR.------ALT.C.PG.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-25 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's claim: 'composite progressional information can better help us to understand the dynamics which surround how all of this has come into being (and how all of this can and will come out of being).' (C)ACT-TR (the concept of actual transformation) is crossed with ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism): the question is what actual-transformation produces when crossed with alternative-composite-progressionalism — the (c) prefix marking that this is the concept of actual transformation, not a particular instance. C-ACT (composite activism) sits at the upper-center. ALT-C-PG itself is the partner. C-ACT and AFI-DY branch from the main line; the AFI-DY line bends at its label and continues to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), and a *dashed* line from DYM-F runs to BSCF (basic science, or basic scientific functionalism). A short unlabeled line from the main line carries CUL-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics), which carries (CT)INFO-F (the criterion of information focus) and a *dashed* line to (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation).
